rationale: Ground truth has no substantive concerns, so recall is vacuous for both. Both catch the key CI-blind-spot (missing pytestmark deselects the new test), but X verifies it with an actual local pytest run showing '18 deselected'/'18 passed' and backs every claim with concrete patches (warmup_quack_fp8 gate bypass, sticky-disable fix, warning_once dedup bug), giving it sharper actionability. Y's findings are grounded but more repetitive/formulaic, and pads with an out-of-scope pre-existing multi-GPU note duplicated across two entries, diluting precision and usefulness.
